Website privacy.

How this website handles the details you enter.

Last updated October 9, 2026.

Preparing a quote request

The quote form prepares a summary in your browser. It does not send a request, email the business, or save your details to a database. The website does not use local storage to save form entries. The form includes a name, phone number, optional email, project location, service, and project description. You choose whether to copy those details and share them with the team.

Calling or copying your details

Phone links open your device’s calling application. The copy button writes the prepared request to your clipboard when you select it. Your device or browser may have its own clipboard and autofill settings.

Maps and external links

Google Maps loads automatically on pages that display the Valley map. Google then handles that map connection under its own privacy policy. The Google Maps business listing also opens on Google’s website. Website hosting may process ordinary connection information to serve pages.
